notes.title: Patch Notes 2021-11-5
notes.content:
"We have been playing ""Hofix Spree"" since the release of Healing Spree. 
Yes, we created a lot of mess with exactly 4 people just like you all playing around in the hospital :)

Okay Okay... We heard from you guys. Here is the improvement!

New stuff
- Spanish language support
- Network quality UI is added
- A ""Next Stage"" button is added

Improvement
- Control sensitivity increased
- Network enhancement
- Stage selection UI is a bit transparent

Fix
- The notice will now pop up when any player disconnected
- Some of the steam achievement descriptions changed
- Fixed lobby kick icon not showing
- Switch Pro controller is now working in bluetooth mode
- Stage 1-7: Stage achievement description is now correct
- Stage 2-4: Shattered glasses are now synchronized between the host and clients
- Stage 2-5: Stage achievement description is now correct. The raft is now floating along t- he river properly
- Stage 2-7: Stage achievement ""Keep All Organs Fresh"" is fixed
- Stage 3-2: Stage achievement description is now correct
- Stage 3-3: The boar can crush you to death no matter where you stand

See you in the hospital. Oops! The in-game hospital I meant."

notes.title: Post-Release Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662450/c987f0ae3e859625434960655afe4aad6a721eda.png

Diagnosis: Update! 

Since Healing Spree’s launch, we’ve been in awe of your hilarious streams, screenshots and social media posts! Though you are all untrained, you are quickly mastering your skills in medical negligence. 

Now, the development team are back to share more about our upcoming roadmap, including key updates and fixes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662450/ba09053bdfe5b2b804cfc653f097814130d40557.png

1. Networking

A few of you might have experienced connection issues; let us explain more about it. Healing Spree is a fast-paced, action multiplayer game with throw/collision physics. To deliver the best experience, we decided to synchronize everything in real-time. All the actions, objects you throw, and collisions are synced through the network in real-time. 

This is a huge challenge for us as it requires a super low latency environment with every object and action synced similar to some hardcore action games. In development, we changed the whole structure 3 times. We went from P2P(peer-to-peer) to dedicated servers, then back to P2P. The reason we are using P2P instead is that we are unable to set up servers around the world. P2P through Steam handles such situations better. 85% of players have a better experience in our beta test through P2P.

To summarize, players should let someone who has the best connection be the host and make sure they are not behind a firewall. 

Our team knows exactly how frustrating a connection problem is, as we are all gamers too. We’ll make sure that enhancing game connection will be one of our top priorities in the upcoming patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662450/4ccc6a6c5d021c0cade924542f86a6e3e1cbe88e.png

2. Controls

We’ve also received your feedback about the game controls and we’re aware that the use and  throw actions in Overcooked are mapped in the same button. However, In Healing Spree, the two buttons are separated. This might take a while in getting used to but allows more flexibility in certain scenarios. The reason behind this is that we have decided to allow players to throw everything. This is different for Overcooked since some items cannot be thrown (like the fire extinguisher) as the button only allows one action at a time.

We believe that allowing players to throw everything in the game would create more strategies and choices in the long run. Therefore, we decided to keep the controls as is. Remember that controls can be rebound to better suit everyone’s playstyle. 

We are also working on enhancing control sensitivity and item snapping. Our priority would be enhancing your control and overall gaming experience. With your reports, we can keep improving the game and grow together with our players.

We will upload a new patch with fixes soon! So stay tuned to our future updates on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook and our Website.

Join our community of (untrained) medical professionals on Discord too to find games, seek support, or just share your hilarious streams.

Till next time!

Paro

notes.title: Healing Spree's Character Creation Contest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662450/c3a59c152c2f210f9397ae43d2635de3161cb6ea.png
Calling all Doctors!

Have you ever wanted to add your very own creation to a game you play? Well, want no more folks, you now have the opportunity to create your own original character for the Healing Spree universe! The winner of the contest will have their original character design implemented into the game as a playable within a future update!

Rules:

 Only one submission is allowed
 Anything goes, can be a drawing, painting, an actual 3D model rendered on software, or even a sculpture! Show us your creativity! 
 Must be created for this contest, not previously used or created for other purposes
 Must be created by you, without any stolen assets
 Submissions will only be accepted and considered if they are posted in the #contest-submissions channel 
 Submissions will only be accepted before 31 Oct, 11:59 PM EST, anything submitted after this date will not be included in the contest unless otherwise approved by the community managers
 No discussions in the event channel please, but feel free to react to the artist’s posts and show some love! Your reactions will help with the final judging
 Ableism, racism, sexism, homophobia, bigotry, or discrimination of any kind will NOT be tolerated nor accepted within this community and contest
 All submissions must follow the server's rules, Steam User Agreement, and Discord Terms of Service

Judging:

Judging will be done by the CM team and dev team. The characters will be critiqued on the following:
[olist]
 How well the character is designed
 Originality and creativity
 Reactions on the submission piece will be considered in the judging process
[/olist]
Prizes and winners:

There will be 1 grand prize winner and 2 runner ups. Prizes will be:

 1st Prize: Your character is fully modeled and added as a playable character, + 4 Healing Spree Keys, + Your name in the credits
 2nd Prize: 4 Healing Spree Keys + Your name in the credits
 3rd Prize: 2 Healing Spree Keys + Your name in the credits

Please join our official discord channel and submit your creations is #contest-submissions
